Human (hg38) 3'UTR Probes

Created by Jeetayu Biswas

Using the Oligostan scripts (paper below) I generated MERFISH/smiFISH style probes for every protein coding gene in the genome. 
This resource is meant to help people without any coding experience order inexpensive and robust RNA FISH probes.

Reference for Oligostan and smiFISH

Reference for MERFISH style protocol

To order smiFISH probes:
First - find and download CDS probes for your gene at one of the databases below, be sure to check both the official gene symbol and the 
ENSEMBL gene ID, if there are not enough probes (at least 15), use the UTR database to supplement
Second - if your gene has multiple trancript variants, double check that you have downloaded all of the corresponding files (many gene 
symbols have multiple files), then use the ENSEMBL gene ID to determine the most abundant variant in your cells
Third - add one of the readout sequences below to both ends of the probes
Finally - order the probes from your favorite supplier in plate format (example invitrogen 96 well order form below)

Readout probe sequences:
These sequences can be directly pasted onto the 5’ and 3’ ends of your encoding probes:
RO1 - ATACTGGAGCGACGCGTGAT 
RO2 - GTTTGAAGATTCGACCTGGA 
RO3 - CTGCAGGTCGACTCTAGAAA 
RO4 - CTAAGGTACCTAATTGCCTAG 
RO5 - CAGTATTCCCGGGTTCATTAG 
RO6 - GTACCGTAGGATCTGATGAA
